scope: Private CPU periodic nonzero-body-gravity implementation check, not public gravity, hydrostatic equilibrium or physical-case admission.
prerequisites: Sealed Debug two-step true-Run smoke and independent native reader passed.
Release helper compile/link passed with the same 85 authoritative non-main objects and unchanged production source.
Three runtime XMLs differ from the sealed control only in two gravity vectors, three explicitly OFF public keys, four clocks and comments; exact original BI4 copies retain initial fields.
sequence: One fresh Release coarse and its independent reader; root safety review before one fresh half and its independent reader. No retained g0 rerun or restart.

predeclared_comparisons.clock: Exact saved times part*2^-23 through 2^-15 seconds; no interpolation, omissions or metadata rewriting.
predeclared_comparisons.coarse_half: Every saved sample: pressure RMS <=5 Pa, material displacement maximum <=0.005 mm; independent normalized pressure/velocity/material-displacement RMS each <=1e-4, using the retained wave scales below.
predeclared_comparisons.same_dt_g0_frame: Every saved sample: the same absolute and normalized p/v/u limits, compared at native IDs against its retained same-dt zero-g trajectory. Only x, vx and material ux are transformed by the prescribed accelerating frame. This is bounded p/v/u frame agreement, not bitwise or all-field equivalence.
predeclared_comparisons.all_columns: Record RMS, maximum absolute and bitwise differences for every one of the 33 common fields; keep native identity, p0, plasticity, load and passive legacy-density checks. J/n/V/rho/k ledger, finite/domain, necessary-step and energy guards remain the existing single-run guards. Do not invent a post-result per-column accuracy threshold or call descriptive stress/theta/normal differences accepted equivalence.
predeclared_comparisons.body_gravity: Independently form native inertial velocity_g - velocity_g0 - g*t, full XYZ RMS divided by the initial velocity amplitude <=1e-4 at every sample. This is a field response comparison, not an assertion of unweighted or mixture-mass center-of-mass conservation.
predeclared_comparisons.negative_body_controls: On the final saved frame, omit or double the g*t subtraction in the comparison formula only. Both resulting field residuals must exceed 100 original velocity budgets. These are comparator negative controls, not trajectories from deliberately faulty solvers. End |g*t| is 0.000244140625 m/s, 1250 original velocity budgets before the admitted residual.
predeclared_comparisons.not_proved: Endpoint p/v/u frame agreement does not independently observe every internal pressure gradient, Darcy flux or force stage. Nonempty actual Gk-dot-g sensitivity and gravity-wall pressure/stress closure remain separate later gates.

preservation: Formal and server inputs/programs/results unchanged; default OFF u-pw remains protected. No GPU gravity, walls, hydrostatic well-balance, full-cycle or physical accuracy claim. Preserve failures and completed solver outputs; repair analysis offline only.
